### 1. About dashboard 

### 1.1 Purpose of dashboard 

## Purpose 

## Data Collection & Integrated Monitoring 

The dashboard uses product specification data from PIM together with crawling data from B2B LG.com pages to support integrated content quality monitoring.



## AX Agent-Assisted Quality Improvement 

The AX Agent provides automated monitoring reports, in-depth analysis, and improvement guidance based on monitoring data. Jira and email integration supports issue follow-up and progress tracking 



## Productivity Through Task Automation 

The dashboard automates crawling-based data collection, quality monitoring, score calculation, and reportinq, reducing repetitive manual work 

## 7 Improved Content Quality & Customer Satisfaction 

Standardizedmonitoringcriteria improve productinformation accuracy andcontentcompleteness.Improved site quality supports highercustomer satisfaction.

3.1 Standard > Scoring Structure & Evaluation Rules 

Scoring Structure & Evaluation Rules 

Monitoring criteria and points vary by page type. The scoring structure shows how each monitoring result contributes to the total score.

## 1 Page Type-Based Scoring 

Select the page type to view its monitoring categories and scoring structure.Diferent criteria apply to CAT/PLP, PDP, Insight,and Industries/Support pages.

### 3. Standard and Schedule 

3.1 Standard > Scoring Structure & Evaluation Rules 

Scoring Structure & Evaluation Rules 

Monitoring criteria and points vary by page type. The scoring structure shows how each monitoring result contributes to the total score.

## Score Calculation 

Criteria with assigned points contribute to the total score, The dashboard calculates the score based on whether each criterion meets the defined condition.

### 3. Standard and Schedule 

3.1 Standard > Scoring Structure & Evaluation Rules 

Scoring Structure & Evaluation Rules 

Monitoring criteria and points vary by page type. The scoring structure shows how each monitoring result contributes to the total score.

## Monitoring-Only Items 

Items listed under Only Monitoring are tracked for status and issue detection but are excluded from the total score.
